headline: Executive order on diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility in the federal government's workforce.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets policy on diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility for people who work for the federal government. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order addresses policies on diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility in their workplaces.
The order covers the federal workforce, which may include how agencies recruit and hire.
Agencies are the ones expected to carry out the workforce policies the order describes.
